title: 1999 AHSME Problem 9
statement: Before Ashley started a three-hour drive, her car’s odometer reading was \(29792,\) a palindrome. (A palindrome is a number that reads the same way from left to right as it does from right to left.) At her destination, the odometer reading was another palindrome. If Ashley never exceeded the speed limit of \(75\) miles per hour, which of the following was her greatest possible average speed?

solutions.text:
The palindromes after \(29792\) are \(29892, 29992, 30003,\) and \(30103.\) In three hours Ashley can drive at most \(3 \cdot 75 = 225\) miles.

Reaching \(30103\) would require \(30103 - 29792 = 311\) miles, which is too far. Reaching \(30003\) requires \(30003 - 29792 = 211\) miles, giving average speed \(\dfrac{211}{3} = 70\tfrac13\) miles per hour.

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: The distance in \(3\) hours cannot exceed \(3 \cdot 75 = 225\) miles
